newsitem.title: USA: National to evaluate Harcourt offer.
newsitem.headline: National to evaluate Harcourt offer.

text.p: National Education Cor confirmed Wednesday it had received an unsolicited takeover offer from Harcourt General Inc and said its board would review the offer.

National Education said it had received a letter from Harcourt indicating its intention to commence a cash tender offer for all of the common stock of National Education at $19.50 per share, valuing the company at about $740 million.
The company said in a statment its board of directors will meet in due course to evaluate the Harcourt General proposal and will advise shareholders as to its conclusion.

Sylvan Learning Systems Inc said earlier it is still proceeding with its agreement to acquire National Education. Last month Sylvan announced its plans to acquire National in a stock deal valued at $750 million at that time. Since then the value of the deal has been eroded to about $650 million.
